headline: 17 killed in suicide bombing at police station in Pakistan
summary: The attack occurred in the Swat region of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province on Sunday evening.
details: At least 17 people were killed and several others were seriously injured in a suicide bombing at a police station in Pakistan's Swat region of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.
A police officer from Swat reported that the bomber detonated explosives on their body as police officers attempted to search the individual upon entering the station.
Security forces believe the attacker was a suicide bomber assisted by several accomplices. A search and investigation operation is currently underway to identify and capture the remaining suspects.
Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed his grief and condemnation of the attack in a statement.
The Pakistani government has attributed the rise in terrorist activities in border areas, where the army and police are frequently targeted,
The Islamabad government has accused the Afghan Taliban of supporting militants, though the Taliban has denied these allegations.
caption:

Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed his grief and condemnation of the attack in a statement.

headline: 3 deaths from dengue in 24 hours, 580 new hospitalizations
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in dengue cases across Bangladesh, with 59 total deaths this year.
details: Three people died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours across Bangladesh, according to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Monday.
During the same period, 580 new patients were admitted to hospitals for dengue treatment. This surge affects multiple divisions, including Dhaka, Chittagong, and Barishal.

The breakdown of new admissions includes 125 from Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 78 from Dhaka South City Corporation, 59 from Dhaka North City Corporation, and 81 from Barishal division.
Other affected areas include Chittagong (79), Khulna (67), Mymensingh (36), Rangpur (31), Rajshahi (22), and Sylhet (2).
So far this year, a total of 16,684 people have been infected with dengue, according to DGHS data.
Of those infected, 62.2% are men and 37.8% are women. To date, 15,344 patients have recovered and been discharged from hospitals.
The total number of dengue-related deaths in Bangladesh has now reached 59 for the current year.
